description: Grades of one generated digest against its source bundle.

faithfulness.description: 1-5. 5: every result, number and comparison is in the source text. 1: several invented or distorted results.

unsupported_claims.description: Claims not supported by the source. `kind` is `contradicted` (the source says otherwise), `absent` (the paper's text in the bundle is complete and does not contain it) or `unverifiable` (the text is truncated and the claim may come from the cut part).

cluster_quality.description: 1-5. 5: every narrative says how its papers relate (shared problem, competing approaches, one result explaining another), citing ids. 1: narratives are lists of summaries.

filler.description: 1-5. 5: no filler or unsupported praise anywhere. 1: filler in most entries.

language.description: 1-5 for the language rules in the rubric.

language_violations.description: Short quotes that break the language rules.

note.description: Two or three sentences: the most important problem, if any.
